purpose: Teach: 責める/信憑/引き合い/駆け引き/特筆/計る/かねる/直近

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者、本気で、絶対、責めるつもりは、絶対、ありません、絶対、警察、絶対、寄り添ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We absolutely have no intent to blame the victim. The police will stand with you every step of the way.
lines.style: Measured and official, but with genuine warmth underneath. Slow, careful delivery on key assurances. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who knows how serious this is and means every word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証言の信憑性、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、検証しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're taking the credibility of your testimony very seriously. The police are handling verification with the utmost care.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive nod in the voice. Calm affirmation. Neither defensive nor deferential—just present and listening. Even pacing. Slight emphasis on 'very seriously' to show alignment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 類似事件を、本気で、絶対、引き合いに、絶対、出して、絶対、捜査、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're drawing on similar cases to guide this investigation forward. The groundwork is thorough.
lines.style: Factual and direct. A slight shift toward procedural confidence—not bragging, just steady competence. Measured pace. Brief pause before the final phrase, suggesting careful deliberation behind every decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、警察様、絶対、駆け引き、絶対、することなく、絶対、誠実に、対応してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company will work with your department in complete good faith, without any attempt at maneuvering. You have our full cooperation.
lines.style: Formal but sincere. Slight emphasis on 'good faith' and 'full cooperation'—these are commitments being made. No hurry in the delivery. The tone of someone speaking on behalf of an organization, but meaning it personally.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、特筆すべき、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This case is receiving particular attention. We're pursuing every significant lead.
lines.style: Slightly firmer than before—conviction without aggression. 'Particular attention' lands with quiet weight. Steady, unhurried pacing. The tone suggests this is being taken to the highest level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員数、本気で、絶対、警察様の、絶対、要請に応じて、絶対、計る形で、提出しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're providing staff numbers and records in whatever format the police require. Whatever you need from us.
lines.style: Accommodating, practical tone. A subtle warmth in 'whatever you need'—not just compliance, but genuine willingness. Steady delivery. No hesitation or condition in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証言、本気で、絶対、応じかねる、絶対、市民、絶対、いらっしゃるんですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Some witnesses understandably find it difficult to come forward. That's something we're seeing in cases like this.
lines.style: Acknowledging and matter-of-fact. No judgment in the voice. A slight pause before 'that's something we're seeing'—showing understanding born from experience. Gentle but clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。直近の防犯活動、本気で、絶対、効果、絶対、出ております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our recent security efforts are already making a difference. We're confident in what we're seeing.
lines.style: A note of quiet satisfaction here—earned, not presumptuous. Calm assurance. Slightly slower pace on 'already making a difference' to let it land. Ends with steady resolve.
